== Description ==

[[Randy Scott]] (mid-left, orange cap under a black hoodie with a large bird/owl graphic, beard, playing), [[Ming Huo]] (left, camel/tan hoodie, face visible, seated), [[Scott Lingrell]] (mid-right table, white-grey hair, black Hall of Fame polo, back to camera, khaki pants, white sneakers), and [[Karl Koenig]] (mid-right table, red pullover, short grey-brown hair, looking down at cards) at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 5 October 2025.
